arrangement_probe.interpretation: Authored adversarial candidates: long loud wrong tone competes with two correct voices. Shows heuristic behavior, not frequency of this error in recordings.

archived_validation.limitations: Cached bass-candidate evaluation, before global quantization, arrangement, notation and playback. Matched-pair errors exclude missed notes and are not overall accuracy. Authored key-command timing is not a human-performance or acoustic-release label. No raw-versus-separated stage traces or full-song piano-arrangement reference is scored here.
